subject: Senior Product Development Manager, Digital Assets: Mark Smalley
headline: Digital Assets Product Development  ·  Blockchain and DLT  ·  Financial Services
role: Senior Product Development Manager, Digital Assets
opening: I am applying for the Senior Product Development Manager role in your Digital Assets team. For over 15 years I have designed and delivered blockchain and digital asset products for regulated financial services, and the work this role describes is the work I do best: turning a deep understanding of the technology into products that legal, compliance and operations teams can stand behind.
body:
The closest parallel is CoKeeps, a licensed digital asset custodian whose compliance, KYC/AML and custody infrastructure I architected. Taking it from concept to regulatory approval took five years of defining requirements with legal, compliance and regulatory stakeholders, and shaping a service that met their standards and worked for clients. Alongside that I advised on a securities regulator's blueprint for blockchain and DLT in capital markets, and delivered training and advisory work on compliance and custody for DBS Bank and Baker Hostetler.

I also know how to get new products off the ground. At CakeDefi I built the first prototype of Ordzaar, a Bitcoin Ordinals marketplace that became the company's fifth business line, and led the innovation team behind it. At Oviato I made the product case for moving from a consumer wallet to business-to-business wallet infrastructure, and built the prototypes behind the investment that followed. Both came down to judging which blockchain capabilities were mature enough to build on, at what cost and at what pace, which is the guidance this role calls for.

My product work has centred on custody, wallets and trading infrastructure, the foundations that payments and liquidity products are built on. I stay hands-on with the technology, which lets me work closely with engineers and designers while keeping business stakeholders clear on the trade-offs.
closing: I am based in Yorkshire and happy to work from London on a hybrid basis. I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could help BNY develop and deliver its digital asset products.
